report:
Reviewed the complete claim: recovery failures must be explicit error nodes backed by diagnostics and must not preserve unresolved choices as successful nodes. The ordinary infer_ctx.rs association satisfies the construction rule: error_expr calls catch, then constructs Ty::Error and TyExprData::Error with the same witness. catch records fresh diagnostics and reuses already-reported witnesses. The captured diagnostic.rs helper pushes the diagnostic before producing its private ErrorReported token. In the supplied implementation, failed/terminally uncertain operator obligations call fail_obligation and recover_expr_slots, which record an error and replace the retained expression slot with an error expression, rather than retaining its successful-looking expression.

The complete associated test set consists of the ordinary failed_operator_proof_becomes_one_diagnostic_and_an_error_node and TODO types_body_diagnosed_recovery. The ordinary test checks bool addition in a checked body, extracts its actual let initializer, and asserts exactly one diagnostic, the associated-type failure message, and TyExprData::Error. Its visible assertions detect a retained successful call or missing diagnostic for that scenario. The TODO explicitly reserves full recovery/completion checks pairing errors with diagnostics across unsupported constructs. That remains a justified coverage deferral: completing it requires representative unsupported-construct recovery paths and whole-body completion fixtures/assertions; this one operator regression does not establish the universal absence of unresolved successful choices. The empty TODO body is not execution evidence. No N/A entries exist. No new concern beyond that declared incomplete matrix was identified.

Baseline: independently compared the current bytes of infer_ctx.rs, representation_spec.rs, and binary_operators.rs to the supplied historical snapshots; all match exactly. Reassessed the historical rationale against current complete claim, association metadata, and both annotated test bodies. Read all initial fragments and captured diagnostic.rs as additional context. Execution: ran review start, review read, and comparison commands; no behavior tests or build executed by this reviewer. The coordinator reports 321 sage-meta tests and a root build passed; those are separate reported evidence, not this reviewer's execution. This assessment accepts the explicitly deferred coverage, not full implementation/test completion.
